The '''Kessel Runners''' were a [[Jango (musical genre)|jango]] [[Band/Legends|band]] that existed during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] child [[Janna (Sullustan)|Janna]] owned a signed [[Holopic/Legends|holopic]] of them.
